essence: Devotion to the true teacher is the prerequisite for the embodied ones.
The supreme reality's great sequence is rooted in the teacher's grace.
One should please the teacher through devotion, wealth, life-breaths, and effort.
When the disciple is liberated, there is no further rebirth.
When the teacher is pleased, the disciple's sins are immediately destroyed.
